hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Extract all base-10 digits of the given integer and compute their sum.

hints.title: Divisibility Invariant
hints.text: Check if the original integer is divisible by the computed digit sum without remainder.

hints.title: Output Value
hints.text: Return the digit sum if x modulo sum equals zero, otherwise return -1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; direct arithmetic is optimal.
